Its animation plays on the stream screen, the same way viewers would see it live.

How the show scales

  • Little Cheers1 to 50 coins: a quick clip each: a wave, a heartbeat, a bounce. Sound matched to the action.
  • Sweet Middle75 to 400: flutters, launches, dances and pops, with a name banner. Sound matched to the action.
  • Showpieces500 to 1,499: centre stage, light rays, coin fountain energy. Sound: a rising swell with chimes.
  • Cosmic550 to 5,000: comets, auroras and a swirling galaxy, with the receiver's name in lights over the stream and spoken out loud. Sound: a shimmering swell.
  • Cozy45 to 320: steams, flickers, rains and purrs, warm and slow. Sound matched to the action.
  • Legends2,000 to 7,500: full screen takeover with the big illustrated characters. Flash, particle storm, receiver's name in lights and spoken out loud. Sound: a full fanfare swell.

Preview only, for approval. Nothing here is connected to the live app, and no coins move.
